In this cut the outfit itself shows that game character: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: the present-day real world — today's clothing, hair, devices and interiors; an ordinary woman of today, nothing of her legend in her clothes.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: her living room with a deep sofa, floor cushions and a low table
Weather / season: spring — blossom petals drifting outside.
Time of day: late morning — clear fresh daylight, soft short shadows; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Zenyatta from Overwatch — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a floor-length gown with a thigh-high slit

COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a cup at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: a soft faraway look with a faint wistful smile. Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.

skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the cosplay SCENE describes. The costume must read at first glance as that game character's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit in the cut SCENE names; she is a real woman in a cosplay, not the character — never the character's face, body or creature shape, no logo or readable text, and no weapon or prop weapon in her hands.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
